environment: Python 3 branches.py run through testkit cli-runner in scratch git repos; gh shim from stub-server returns the rule list; Node test runner

cases.title: starts_with feature/ gives feature/sdlc/{name}; samples prefixed; name prints feature/sdlc/S-001
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: exit 0, ok, derived, format feature/sdlc/{name}, slice/e2e samples exact, state sample prefix + 14 digits
cases.expected: exit 0, ok, derived, format feature/sdlc/{name}, slice/e2e samples exact, state sample prefix + 14 digits
cases.actual: as expected; name --format prints branch feature/sdlc/S-001

cases.title: Prefix corners: regex chars, space, no trailing slash
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: literal concatenation; a prefix with a space is not derivable
cases.expected: literal concatenation; a prefix with a space is not derivable
cases.actual: f.+(a)/ -> f.+(a)/sdlc/{name} derived; feature -> featuresdlc/{name} derived; 'my team/' -> derived false, exit 1

cases.title: ends_with -dev gives sdlc/{name}-dev, exit 0, slice sample sdlc/S-001-dev
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: ok true, derived true, format sdlc/{name}-dev, exit 0
cases.expected: ok true, derived true, format sdlc/{name}-dev, exit 0

cases.title: Suffix corners .x, -, _dev
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: derived and every sample ends with suffix and passes
cases.expected: derived and every sample ends with suffix and passes

cases.title: contains team-a gives sdlc/team-a/{name}, exit 0
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: ok true, derived true, format sdlc/team-a/{name}
cases.expected: ok true, derived true, format sdlc/team-a/{name}

cases.title: Derived format passes every sample; rule null; no fail; repo tree unchanged
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: every sample pass with rule null, no fail sample, no file written
cases.expected: every sample pass with rule null, no fail sample, no file written

cases.title: No derivation: flag, config, two rules, negated starts_with, regex, negated ends_with, negated contains
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.then: derived false, ok false, exit 1; format team/{name} for flag and config, sdlc/{name} otherwise; tree unchanged
cases.expected: derived false, ok false, exit 1; format team/{name} for flag and config, sdlc/{name} otherwise; tree unchanged

cases.title: Empty rule list and unknown operator
cases.given: scratch git repo, gitMode pr, forge github, gh shim returning the rule
cases.when: branches.py preflight --mode pr (and name where noted)
cases.actual: empty: exit 0 ok; unknown operator: exit 0, samples unevaluated, note 'cannot evaluate r: unknown kind frobnicate', derived false

seeds.title: preflight suggests a format that validate_format rejects
seeds.detail: A starts_with rule with prefix 'my team/' gives derived false and suggestion --branch-format "my team/sdlc/{name}", which contains a space and is not a valid format. A prefix with no trailing slash derives featuresdlc/{name}, which is valid but probably not what the user wants.
